_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: atom-heal can repair cards in a project memory folder (--memory-root): links from project cards up to global cards count as valid and global cards are offered as repoint targets; heal-review resolve keeps the card and prints the reason when the rescan fails, and --force still clears it; memory-audit --restore is now a complete undo of a retire: Confidence, the usage record, the index entry (Related, Aka, Entry, Depends) and the catalog come back as they were; a trigger containing a pipe character no longer splits its row in the _ATOM_INDEX.md mirror, merges keep untouched rows as they are, and sync-atom-index --check also compares the mirror; eval_usage.py writes the report to the path given with --report
